servicesSummary: Government of the Republic of sierra Weintraub Communications LLC engaged in outreach to U.S.-based Leone media organizatoins and journalists on behalf of the Government of sierra Leone, including offering a Government representative for interviews and soliciting outlets to publish an opinion article by the President of sierra Leone.
